paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The famous Halmidi inscription, regarded as the earliest recorded stone inscription in classical Kannada, belongs to which dynasty?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The Halmidi inscription discovered in Belur taluk dates to c. 450 AD during the reign of King Kakusthavarma of the Kadamba dynasty.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who was the court poet who composed the Aihole Prashasti praising Pulakeshin II's military triumphs over Emperor Harsha?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Ravikirti composed the Aihole inscription in 634 AD, detailing Badami Chalukya King Pulakeshin II's victory over Harshavardhana on the Narmada.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The colossal 57-foot monolithic statue of Gommateshwara at Shravanabelagola was consecrated in 981 AD by which Ganga general?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Chavundaraya, military commander and Prime Minister of Western Ganga King Rachamalla IV, commissioned the Gommateshwara monolith in 981 AD.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The famous rock-cut monolithic Kailasanatha Temple at Ellora (Cave 16) was excavated under which Rashtrakuta monarch?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Rashtrakuta King Krishna I (756–774 AD) patronized the excavation of the world-famous monolithic Kailasa temple at Ellora.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The historic Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336 AD on the banks of which river?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Brothers Harihara I and Bukka I founded the Vijayanagara Empire on the southern banks of River Tungabhadra near Hampi.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who composed 'Kavirajamarga', the earliest available literary work in Kannada discussing poetics, grammar, and Karnataka geography?
options: Sri Vijaya (under patronage of Amoghavarsha I)
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Kavirajamarga (c. 850 AD) was authored by court poet Sri Vijaya under the patronage of Rashtrakuta King Amoghavarsha I Nrupatunga.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which sultan of the Bahmani kingdom built the world-famous Gol Gumbaz in Vijayapura featuring the whispering gallery?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Mohammed Adil Shah (reigned 1627–1656) built the magnificent Gol Gumbaz as his royal mausoleum.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The celebrated Persian scholar Mahmud Gawan established a renowned Islamic madrasa and library in 1472 at which Karnataka city?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Mahmud Gawan, prime minister of the Bahmani Sultanate, established the three-story Mahmud Gawan Madrasa in Bidar.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who was the British Political Agent and Collector of Dharwad killed in battle by Rani Chennamma of Kittur in October 1824?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: St. John Thackeray was killed outside the Kittur fort gates on 23 October 1824 when attempting to seize Kittur under the Doctrine of Lapse.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Sangolli Rayanna, the legendary military commander of Kittur, was executed by the British at which location on 26 January 1831?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Sangolli Rayanna was captured by betrayal and hanged by the British colonial authorities on 26 January 1831 at Nandagad.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which freedom tragedy in Karnataka is widely known as the 'Jallianwala Bagh of Karnataka'?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: On 25 April 1938, British police opened fire on unarmed freedom fighters hoisting the tricolour at Vidurashwatha in modern Chikkaballapur district, killing over 35 people.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The first village in Karnataka to declare independence during the Quit India Movement of 1942 was:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Villagers of Isur in Shikaripura taluk declared their village independent in 1942, leading to the trial and hanging of 5 patriots.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Mysore State was officially renamed as 'Karnataka' on 1st November 1973 under the tenure of which Chief Minister?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Chief Minister D. Devaraj Urs officially renamed Mysore State as 'Karnataka' on Rajyotsava day, 1 November 1973.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who presided over the historic Belgaum (Belagavi) Session of the Indian National Congress in 1924?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The 39th session of the INC at Belgaum in December 1924 was the only Congress session ever presided over by Mahatma Gandhi.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who composed the iconic Kannada state anthem 'Jaya Bharata Jananiya Tanujate'?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Rashtrakavi Kuvempu penned the poem which was officially adopted as the State Anthem of Karnataka in 2004.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who was the Dewan of Mysore who established Mysore University (1916) and the Iron and Steel Works at Bhadravati?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Bharat Ratna Sir M. Visvesvaraya served as Dewan of Mysore from 1912 to 1918 and founded Mysore University, KRS Dam, and Bhadravati Iron Works.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The 'Halagali Beda Revolt' of 1857 in Mudhol principality was fought primarily against which British act?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The Bedas of Halagali revolted in 1857 refusing to surrender their traditional firearms under the British Disarming Act.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who was known as 'Karnataka Kulapurohita' for his pioneering leadership in the Karnataka Unification Movement?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Aluru Venkata Rao authored 'Karnataka Gatha Vaibhava' in 1912 and is celebrated as the Karnataka Kulapurohita.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Tipu Sultan died defending his capital Srirangapatna in the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War on which date?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Tipu Sultan died fighting valiantly at the Water Gate of Srirangapatna fort on 4 May 1799.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The famous Shivapura Flag Satyagraha in Mandya district was organized in which year?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: In April 1938, thousands assembled at Maddur/Shivapura in Mandya under T. Siddalingaiah to hoist the national tricolor.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Karnataka History

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the highest mountain peak in Karnataka?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Mullayanagiri in the Baba Budan Giri range of Chikkamagaluru district stands at 1,930 meters, making it the highest elevation in Karnataka.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The world-famous Jog Falls (Gersoppa) is formed across which river?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Jog Falls (253 m plunge) is formed by the Sharavathi River in Sagara taluk of Shivamogga district.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: At which confluence do the rivers Tunga and Bhadra merge to form the Tungabhadra River?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Tunga and Bhadra originate in Gangamoola (Western Ghats) and merge at Kudli in Shivamogga district to form Tungabhadra.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which village in Karnataka is popularly hailed as the 'Cherrapunji of South India' due to its high annual rainfall?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Agumbe in Thirthahalli taluk of Shivamogga district receives over 7,500 mm of annual rainfall.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Almatti Dam constructed across the Krishna River forms a reservoir officially named:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Almatti Dam forms the Lal Bahadur Shastri Sagar reservoir, while Narayanpur Dam downstream forms the Basava Sagar.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Krishna Raja Sagara (KRS) Dam is constructed just below the confluence of Kaveri with which two tributary rivers?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: KRS Dam is built across Kaveri near Kannambadi where the Hemavati and Lakshmantirtha join the main river.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which bird sanctuary in Karnataka is located on an island in the Kaveri river near Srirangapatna?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary in Mandya district comprises 6 islets in the Kaveri river.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which national park in Karnataka is famous for its evergreen rainforests and Lion-tailed Macaques, and was declared a World Heritage Site?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Kudremukh National Park in Chikkamagaluru/Dakshina Kannada contains extensive shola-grassland ecosystems and Lion-tailed Macaques.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Black soil (Regur soil) in Karnataka is exceptionally well-suited for the cultivation of which commercial crop?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Black cotton soil (Regur), rich in clay and moisture-retentive montmorillonite, is ideal for cotton cultivation in North Karnataka.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which district in Karnataka is the largest producer of coffee in India?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Kodagu produces more than 35% of India's coffee, followed closely by Chikkamagaluru and Hassan.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Ten Degree Channel ($10^\circ\text{ N}$) separates which two island groups in the Bay of Bengal?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The 10-degree latitude channel separates the Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which Indian state shares the longest international land border with Bangladesh?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: West Bengal shares 2,217 km of the total 4,096.7 km India-Bangladesh border.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The older, less fertile alluvium of the Northern Great Plains containing calcareous kankar nodules is called:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Bhangar is the older alluvial soil deposited above flood plains, containing calcium carbonate nodules (kankar).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which is the highest mountain peak in the entire Peninsular South India?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Anamudi in the Anaimalai Hills of Kerala stands at 2,695 meters and is the highest peak in South India.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Standard Meridian of India ($82^\circ 30' \text{ E}$) passes through which town near Prayagraj?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The Indian Standard Time meridian passes through Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh ($+5:30$ GMT).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which two major Indian rivers flow westward through tectonic rift valleys and empty into the Arabian Sea?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Both Narmada and Tapi flow west between Vindhya and Satpura rift valleys without forming deltas.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which is the largest brackish water coastal lagoon in India?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Chilika Lake in Odisha is Asia's largest brackish water coastal lagoon.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which pass in the Western Ghats connects Mangaluru with Bengaluru via Hassan?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Shiradi Ghat along NH-75 connects the port city of Mangaluru to Sakaleshpur and Bengaluru.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Geography

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' were added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution by which amendment?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act 1976 inserted Socialist, Secular, and Integrity into the Preamble.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which Article of the Constitution abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability and makes its enforcement a punishable offence under law.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which Article was described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul of the Indian Constitution'?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Article 32 guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies, empowering citizens to approach the Supreme Court for writ relief.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV) in the Indian Constitution were borrowed from the constitution of which country?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Directive Principles (Articles 36 to 51) were adapted from the 1937 Constitution of Ireland.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Fundamental Duties were incorporated into Article 51A under Part IVA upon the recommendation of which committee?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The Swaran Singh Committee recommended incorporating Fundamental Duties during the 42nd Amendment in 1976.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution can the President impose Financial Emergency in India?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Article 360 provides for the proclamation of Financial Emergency (never declared in India so far).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the minimum age prescribed under the Constitution for a person to be eligible for election as a Member of the Lok Sabha?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Article 84(b) prescribes a minimum age of 25 years for Lok Sabha and 30 years for Rajya Sabha.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which constitutional amendment reduced the voting age in India from 21 years to 18 years?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The 61st Amendment Act 1988 (effective 1989) lowered the voting age for Lok Sabha and Legislative Assemblies to 18.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Article 371J of the Constitution providing special reservation for Kalyana-Karnataka was enacted by which amendment?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The 98th Constitutional Amendment Act 2012 inserted Article 371J for the Hyderabad-Karnataka (now Kalyana-Karnataka) region.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Eleventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution added by the 73rd Amendment contains how many functional matters for Panchayats?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The Eleventh Schedule enumerates 29 developmental and administrative subjects entrusted to Panchayati Raj bodies.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What percentage of reservation is provided for women in Panchayati Raj institutions across Karnataka?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Karnataka has enacted 50% reservation for women in all three tiers of Panchayati Raj institutions.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which writ is issued by the Supreme Court or High Court commanding a public official to perform a statutory duty?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Mandamus (meaning 'We Command') compels a public authority or court to execute a mandatory statutory duty.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who acts as the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States)?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Under Article 64, the Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: How many members can the Governor of Karnataka nominate to the Karnataka Legislative Council?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Under Article 171(3)(e), 1/6th of total members of Legislative Council are nominated by the Governor.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India submits audit reports relating to state accounts to:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Under Article 151(2), CAG reports relating to the accounts of a State are submitted to the Governor.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under which Article does the Governor have the power to promulgate Ordinances during the recess of the State Legislature?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Article 213 empowers the Governor to promulgate ordinances; Article 123 applies to the President.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the Uniform Civil Code for the citizens?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Article 44 in Part IV (DPSP) directs the State to secure a Uniform Civil Code for all citizens throughout India.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners are appointed by:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Under Article 324(2), the President of India appoints the Chief Election Commissioner and Election Commissioners.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Indian Polity

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under the Karnataka Gram Swaraj and Panchayat Raj Act, 1993, what is the minimum population benchmark for constituting a Grama Panchayat in general areas?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: A Grama Panchayat is declared for a village or group of villages having a population between 5,000 and 7,000 (2,500 in hill areas).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who acts as the Member-Secretary and Chief Executive of the Grama Panchayat under the Karnataka Panchayat Raj Act?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The Panchayat Development Officer (PDO) is the administrative head and executive authority of the Grama Panchayat.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the quorum required for holding a valid meeting of the Gram Sabha in Karnataka?
options: 1/10th of total voters (with minimum 30% women and SC/ST representation)
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Under the Karnataka Act, Gram Sabha quorum is 1/10th of total voters or 100 members, with statutory representation of women and SC/ST members.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: In the state revenue administration hierarchy of Karnataka, who is the immediate superior officer to the Village Administrative Officer (VAO)?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The administrative hierarchy is: DC $\to$ AC $\to$ Tahsildar $\to$ Revenue Inspector (RI) $\to$ Village Administrative Officer (VAO).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964, which statutory document is issued as Form 16?
options: Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops (RTC / Pahani)
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Form 16 under the KLR Act represents the computerized Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops (RTC / Pahani).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Land Records IT

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under Section 129 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964, mutations are processed in the Bhoomi software strictly on the basis of:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Bhoomi enforces First-In, First-Out (FIFO) queue processing to eliminate arbitrary delays and corruption in mutation approvals.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Land Records IT

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the pre-registration digital survey sketch required under the Mojini system before partitioning agricultural land?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: An 11E sketch prepared by a licensed or departmental surveyor is mandatory prior to registered partition or sale of partial hissas.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Land Records IT

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the accelerated administrative scheme in Karnataka enabling individual farmers to demarcate joint survey plots into independent hissas?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Tatkal Podi enables individual farmers to get their survey hissas separated rapidly without waiting for whole-village surveys.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Land Records IT

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Dishank mobile application was developed by which agency to provide real-time revenue survey numbers on smartphones?
options: KSRSAC (Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre)
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: KSRSAC developed Dishank to link smartphone GPS coordinates with digitized cadastral survey maps.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Land Records IT

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which online application is used by Gram Panchayats in Karnataka to issue digital property ownership certificates (Form 9 & 11)?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: e-Swathu issues digitized Form 9 and Form 11 property certificates to eliminate fraudulent non-agricultural rural property transactions.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the term of office of the Adhyaksha and Upadhyaksha of a Grama Panchayat in Karnataka as per the 2015 amendment?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The 2015 amendment extended the term of Adhyaksha and Upadhyaksha of Grama Panchayats from 30 months to 5 years (matching the full term).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who is the competent revenue authority to sanction the conversion of agricultural land for non-agricultural purposes under Section 95 of KLR Act?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Under Section 95 of the KLR Act 1964, the Deputy Commissioner of the district is empowered to grant land conversion permissions.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Register of Mutations under the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules is maintained in which statutory form?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Form 12 is the Mutation Register where changes in title, inheritance, or sale are recorded before certification.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Land Records IT

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: When an agricultural land parcel is uncultivable due to rocks, ravines, or nalas, it is classified in the village land register as:
options: Kharab Land (Class A or Class B)
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Pot Kharab represents uncultivable land: Class A is reserved for agricultural uncultivable portions; Class B is public utility/government land.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Government land reserved around villages for common cattle grazing is officially known in Karnataka as:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Gomala is government land specifically reserved for village communal grazing rights.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which section of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 obligates every landholder acquiring rights by inheritance or purchase to report the acquisition within 3 months?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Section 128 obliges any person acquiring rights to land to report the acquisition to the prescribed revenue officer within three months.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Land Records IT

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the primary role of the Village Administrative Officer (VAO) during natural disasters like floods or drought?
options: Conduct immediate crop damage enumeration and prepare disaster relief beneficiary rolls
Disburse cash directly from personal account
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The VAO conducts spot inspections, enumerates affected farmers, estimates crop loss percentages, and submits joint verification lists for relief.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, what is the fee paid for obtaining an official signed copy of the computerized RTC (Pahani)?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Official computerized RTCs are issued through Atalji Janasnehi / Nada Kacheri kiosks at the statutory fee of ₹15.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Land Records IT

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The 'Kaveri 2.0' software implemented by the Department of Stamps and Registration integrates with Bhoomi for:
options: Automatic online intimation of registered sale deeds (J-Slip) to trigger mutation
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Kaveri 2.0 pushes registered land transaction data electronically to Bhoomi via J-Slip to begin mutation automatically.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Land Records IT

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The process of conducting a complete survey and updating land records of a whole village to resolve historical hissa divisions is called:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Podi Muktha Grama is the state campaign aimed at eliminating all joint survey hissa ambiguities village by village.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the minimum age prescribed for contesting an election to a Grama Panchayat in Karnataka?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years to contest local body elections in India.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Karnataka State Election Commission is headed by a State Election Commissioner appointed under Article:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Article 243K mandates the superintendence, direction, and control of panchayat elections in a State Election Commission.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Rural Administration

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under the Government of Karnataka's 'Gruha Lakshmi' scheme, what is the monthly financial assistance transferred via DBT to eligible women family heads?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Gruha Lakshmi deposits ₹2,000 per month directly into the bank accounts of designated women heads of eligible Antyodaya, BPL, and APL families.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The 'Shakti' scheme provides free public bus travel for women and transgender persons across Karnataka in which state transport corporations?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Shakti is valid across all 4 state road transport corporations (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC) in ordinary and express buses.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under the 'Yuva Nidhi' scheme, what is the monthly financial stipend provided to unemployed Degree Graduates and Diploma holders respectively?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Yuva Nidhi provides ₹3,000 per month for degree graduates and ₹1,500 for diploma holders for up to two years of unemployment.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under the 'Anna Bhagya' scheme, when physical rice supply is constrained, the Karnataka Government disburses cash DBT for the additional 5 kg rice at what rate per kg?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The state provides cash DBT at ₹34 per kg (₹170 per person per month) for the 5 kg rice portion.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the maximum limit of free domestic electricity provided per household per month under the 'Gruha Jyothi' guarantee scheme?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Gruha Jyothi provides zero electricity bills up to 200 units per month based on the household's 12-month average consumption plus 10%.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the total expenditure outlay of the Karnataka State Budget 2026–27 presented on 6 March 2026?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The Karnataka State Budget 2026–27 outlay is ₹4,48,004 crore.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who assumed office as the Chief Minister of Karnataka on 3 June 2026 following the state leadership transition?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: D.K. Shivakumar assumed the office of Chief Minister of Karnataka on 3 June 2026.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which new scheme was announced in Karnataka Budget 2026–27 to shift agricultural irrigation pumps to grid-connected solar power feeders?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: The Mukhya Mantri Saura Krishi Yojane solarizes rural agricultural feeders to deliver uninterrupted daytime power to farmers.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What total annual financial allocation is earmarked in Budget 2026–27 to fund the Five Guarantee Schemes?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Budget 2026–27 allocated ₹51,286 crore exclusively for the five guarantees.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Under the SVAMITVA scheme, large-scale drone mapping of rural abadi lands is executed at which map scale?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: SVAMITVA drone mapping in rural abadi areas is conducted at an ultra-precise 1:500 scale to issue legal property ownership cards.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which city in Karnataka is being strategically developed as the secondary technology and semiconductor park under the 'Beyond Bengaluru' initiative in Budget 2026–27?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Mysuru has been prioritized as the state's secondary technology and semiconductor hub under 'Beyond Bengaluru'.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The Karnataka Government recently proposed a landmark social policy framework to restrict algorithmic social media access for children under what age?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Karnataka announced a pioneering child safety policy restricting algorithmic social media access for youth under 16 years.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which ISRO lunar mission accomplished the historic soft-landing on the Moon's South Polar region?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander touched down near the lunar South Pole on 23 August 2023 (National Space Day).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: India's first dedicated solar observation space observatory positioned at Lagrange Point 1 (L1) is named:
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: ISRO launched Aditya-L1 to halo orbit L1 to study coronal heating, solar wind, and coronal mass ejections.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Who was conferred the 58th Jnanpith Award in 2024 for outstanding contributions to Sanskrit and Urdu literature respectively?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Sanskrit scholar Jagadguru Rambhadracharya and renowned lyricist/author Gulzar were jointly awarded the 58th Jnanpith.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which district in Karnataka was carved out as the 31st district of the state in October 2021?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Vijayanagara (headquartered at Hosapete) was carved out of Ballari district as Karnataka's 31st district.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: Current Affairs

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which blood group is universally known as the 'Universal Donor'?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: O negative (O-) blood lacks A, B, and Rh antigens, allowing it to be safely transfused to any recipient in emergency.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Deficiency of Vitamin D in children leads to which disease characterized by weak and soft bones?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Vitamin D deficiency causes Rickets in children and Osteomalacia in adults.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which chemical compound is commonly known as 'Plaster of Paris'?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Plaster of Paris is Calcium Sulphate Hemihydrate ($CaSO_4 \cdot \frac{1}{2}H_2O$).
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: The blue color of the clear daytime sky is caused by which optical phenomenon?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Rayleigh scattering scatters shorter blue wavelengths much more than longer red wavelengths.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: What is the primary greenhouse gas contributing to global climate change?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Carbon Dioxide ($CO_2$) accounts for over 75% of global anthropogenic greenhouse emissions.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: General Science

paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.text: Which hormone secreted by the pancreas regulates glucose levels in human blood?
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.explanation: Beta cells of the pancreas secrete Insulin to maintain blood glucose homeostasis.
paper_1_general_knowledge_and_rural_admi.subject: General Science

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಒಟ್ಟು ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಎಷ್ಟು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಟ್ಟು 49 ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳಿವೆ (ಸ್ವರಗಳು 14, ವ್ಯಂಜನಗಳು 34, ಯೋಗವಾಹಗಳು 2).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: ಕನ್ನಡ ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಯೋಗವಾಹಗಳು' ಎಷ್ಟು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಯೋಗವಾಹಗಳು 2: ಅನುಸ್ವಾರ (o) ಮತ್ತು ವಿಸರ್ಗ (:).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: ವರ್ಗೀಯ ವ್ಯಂಜನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಗದ 2ನೇ ಮತ್ತು 4ನೇ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳನ್ನು ಏನೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಉಸಿರು ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸುವ 2ನೇ ಮತ್ತು 4ನೇ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳು ಮಹಾಪ್ರಾಣಗಳು (ಉದಾ: ಖ, ಘ, ಛ, ಝ...).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: ಮೂಗಿನ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ಉಚ್ಚರಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಗದ 5ನೇ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳಿಗೆ ಏನೆಂದು ಹೆಸರು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಙ, ಞ, ಣ, ನ, ಮ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುನಾಸಿಕಗಳೆಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವರ್ಣಮಾಲೆ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಹೊತ್ತಿಗೆ + ಇಲ್ಲ = ಹೊತ್ತಿಗಿಲ್ಲ' — ಈ ಸಂಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಸಂಧಿ ನಿಯಮ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಸ್ವರದ ಮುಂದೆ ಸ್ವರ ಬಂದು ಅರ್ಥ ಕೆಡದಿದ್ದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ವಪದದ ಕೊನೆಯ ಸ್ವರವು ಲೋಪವಾಗುವುದು 'ಲೋಪ ಸಂಧಿ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಂಧಿಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಮಳೆ + ಕಾಲ = ಮಳೆಗಾಲ' — ಇದು ಯಾವ ಸಂಧಿಗೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಉತ್ತರಪದದ ಆದಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕ-ತ-ಪ ಗಳಿಗೆ ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಗ-ದ-ಬ ಗಳು ಆದೇಶವಾಗಿ ಬರುವುದು ಆದೇಶ ಸಂಧಿ (ಕಾಲ → ಗಾಲ).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಂಧಿಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಗುರು + ಉಪದೇಶ = ಗುರೂಪದೇಶ' — ಇದು ಯಾವ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಸಂಧಿಯಾಗಿದೆ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಸಮಾನ ಸ್ವರಗಳು ಸೇರಿದಾಗ ದೀರ್ಘ ಸ್ವರವು ಆದೇಶವಾಗಿ ಬರುವುದು ಸವರ್ಣದೀರ್ಘ ಸಂಧಿ (ಉ + ಉ = ಊ).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಂಧಿಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ದೇವ + ಇಂದ್ರ = ದೇವೇಂದ್ರ' — ಇದು ಯಾವ ಸಂಧಿಗೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಅ-ಆ ಕಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಇ-ಈ ಕಾರಗಳು ಪರವಾದರೆ 'ಏ' ಕಾರವು ಆದೇಶವಾಗಿ ಬರುವುದು ಗುಣ ಸಂಧಿ.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಂಧಿಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಏಕ + ಏಕ = ಏಕೈಕ' — ಈ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸಂಧಿಯನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಅ-ಆ ಕಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಏ-ಐ ಕಾರಗಳು ಪರವಾದರೆ 'ಐ' ಕಾರವು ಬರುವುದು ವೃದ್ಧಿ ಸಂಧಿ.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಂಧಿಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಕೈ + ಅನ್ನು = ಕೈಯನ್ನು' — ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂದಿರುವ ಸಂಧಿ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಸ್ವರಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯೆ 'ಯ್' ಅಕ್ಷರವು ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಬಂದು ಸೇರುವುದು ಯ-ಕಾರಾಗಮ ಸಂಧಿ.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಂಧಿಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಅರಸನ + ಮನೆ = ಅರಮನೆ' — ಇದು ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ವಿಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದಲೂ, ಉತ್ತರಪದವು ನಾಮಪದದಿಂದಲೂ ಕೂಡಿ ಉತ್ತರಪದದ ಅರ್ಥ ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ 'ತತ್ಪುರುಷ ಸಮಾಸ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಮಾಸಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಇಮ್ಮಡಿ' (ಎರಡು + ಮಡಿ) — ಈ ಸಮಾಸ ಪದವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ಸಂಖ್ಯಾ ವಾಚಕವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಉತ್ತರಪದವು ನಾಮಪದವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ 'ದ್ವಿಗು ಸಮಾಸ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಮಾಸಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಮುಕ್ಕಣ್ಣ' (ಮೂರು ಕಣ್ಣುಳ್ಳವನು ಯಾರೋ ಅವನು - ಶಿವ) — ಇದು ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಸಮಸ್ತ ಪದವು ಬೇರೊಂದು ಅನ್ಯ ಪದದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸಿದರೆ ಅದು 'ಬಹುವ್ರೀಹಿ ಸಮಾಸ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಮಾಸಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ರಾಮಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣರು' (ರಾಮನೂ + ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣನೂ) — ಇದು ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಎರಡೂ ಅಥವಾ ಹಲವು ಪದಗಳ ಅರ್ಥವೂ ಪ್ರಧಾನವಾಗಿರುವ ಸಮಾಸವೇ 'ದ್ವಂದ್ವ ಸಮಾಸ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಮಾಸಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಹೆಮ್ಮರ' (ಹಿರಿದು + ಮರ) — ಈ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸಮಾಸ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ವಿಶೇಷಣವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಉತ್ತರಪದವು ವಿಶೇಷ್ಯವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಅದು 'ಕರ್ಮಧಾರಯ ಸಮಾಸ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಮಾಸಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಮುಂಗೈ' (ಕೈಯ + ಮುಂದು) — ಈ ಸಮಾಸ ಪದವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಅಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಶೀ ಭಾವ ಸಂಬಂಧವಿದ್ದು, ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ಅವಯವದ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿದರೆ 'ಅಂಶಿ ಸಮಾಸ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಮಾಸಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಕೈಮುಗಿ' (ಕೈಯನ್ನು + ಮುಗಿ) — ಇದು ಯಾವ ಸಮಾಸ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಪೂರ್ವಪದವು ದ್ವಿತೀಯಾಂತ ನಾಮಪದವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಉತ್ತರಪದವು ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ 'ಕ್ರಿಯಾ ಸಮಾಸ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಮಾಸಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ವರ್ಷ' ಎಂಬ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕನ್ನಡ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ತತ್ಸಮ 'ವರ್ಷ' ಪದವು ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ 'ಬರುಷ' ಅಥವಾ 'ವರುಷ' ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ತದ್ಭವ 'ಬರುಷ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ತತ್ಸಮ-ತದ್ಭವ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ' ಎಂಬ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ' ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕನ್ನಡ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ 'ಅಚ್ಚರಿ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ತತ್ಸಮ-ತದ್ಭವ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಸ್ವರ್ಗ' ಎಂಬ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'ಸ್ವರ್ಗ' ಪದದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ 'ಸಗ್ಗ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ತತ್ಸಮ-ತದ್ಭವ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಮುಖ' ಎಂಬ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'ಮುಖ' ತತ್ಸಮದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ತದ್ಭವ 'ಮೊಗ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ತತ್ಸಮ-ತದ್ಭವ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಕಾವ್ಯ' ಎಂಬ ತತ್ಸಮ ಪದದ ತದ್ಭವ ರೂಪ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'ಕಾವ್ಯ' ಪದದ ಹಳಗನ್ನಡ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ತದ್ಭವ 'ಕಬ್ಬ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ತತ್ಸಮ-ತದ್ಭವ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ 'ತೃತೀಯಾ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ'ಯ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಪ್ರಥಮಾ (ಉ), ದ್ವಿತೀಯಾ (ಅನ್ನು), ತೃತೀಯಾ (ಇಂದ), ಚತುರ್ಥೀ (ಗೆ/ಇಗೆ/ಕ್ಕೆ). ತೃತೀಯಾ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ 'ಇಂದ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಮರದಲ್ಲಿ' ಎಂಬ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಸಪ್ತಮೀ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿಯ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ 'ಅಲ್ಲಿ' (ಅಧಿಕರಣ ಕಾರಕಾರ್ಥ).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಚತುರ್ಥೀ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ'ಯ ಕಾರಕಾರ್ಥ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಪ್ರಥಮಾ-ಕರ್ತೃ, ದ್ವಿತೀಯಾ-ಕರ್ಮ, ತೃತೀಯಾ-ಕರಣ, ಚತುರ್ಥೀ-ಸಂಪ್ರದಾನ (ಕೊಡುವ ಕ್ರಿಯೆ).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ರಾಮನ' ಎಂಬ ಪದದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಷಷ್ಠೀ ವಿಭಕ್ತಿಯ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಯ 'ಅ' (ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕಾರಕಾರ್ಥ: ರಾಮ + ಅ = ರಾಮನ).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವಿಭಕ್ತಿ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಅತ್ತೆಗೊಂದು ಕಾಲ, ಸೊಸೆಗೊಂದು ಕಾಲ' — ಈ ಗಾದೆ ಮಾತಿನ ಭಾವಾರ್ಥವೇನು?
options: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಅವಕಾಶ ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರಾಬಲ್ಯದ ಸಮಯ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಕಾಲಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಅನುಕೂಲಕರ ಸಂದರ್ಭ ಒದಗಿಬರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಈ ಗಾದೆ ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಗಾದೆಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ತುಂಬಿದ ಕೊಡ ತುಳುಕುವುದಿಲ್ಲ' ಎಂಬ ಗಾದೆ ಮಾತು ಯಾರ ಲಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಬಣ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಸದ್ಗುಣವುಳ್ಳ ಗಂಭೀರ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯು ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಜಂಭ ಕೊಚ್ಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಗಾದೆಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಕೈ ಕೆಸರಾದರೆ ಬಾಯಿ ಮೊಸರು' ಎಂಬ ನಾಣ್ಣುಡಿಯ ಅರ್ಥವೇನು?
options: ಕಷ್ಟಪಟ್ಟು ಕಾಯಕ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಫಲ ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕ ಪರಿಶ್ರಮ ಮತ್ತು ದುಡಿಮೆಯಿಂದ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸುಖ-ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿ ಪ್ರಾಪ್ತಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಗಾದೆಗಳು)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಅನುಕೂಲ' ಪದದ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'ಅನುಕೂಲ' ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ನೇರ ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ 'ಪ್ರತಿಕೂಲ' ಅಥವಾ 'ಅನನುಕೂಲ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಕೀರ್ತಿ' ಪದದ ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'ಕೀರ್ತಿ' ಗೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಪದ 'ಅಪಕೀರ್ತಿ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವಿರುದ್ಧಾರ್ಥಕ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ಭಾನು' ಎಂಬ ಪದದ ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'ಭಾನು', 'ರವಿ', 'ದಿನಕರ', 'ಭಾಸ್ಕರ' ಇವೆಲ್ಲವೂ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ ಪದಗಳು.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಸಮಾನಾರ್ಥಕ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: ಕೆಳಗಿನವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣಬದ್ಧ ವಾಕ್ಯವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ:
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಲಿಂಗ-ವಚನ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೌರವ ಬಹುವಚನ 'ಅವರು' ಜೊತೆಗೆ 'ಬಂದರು' ಸರಿಯಾದ ರೂಪ.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವಾಕ್ಯದೋಷ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: 'ತಪ್ಪುಗಳಿಲ್ಲದ' ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮುದ್ರಣ ರೂಪವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ:
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ರೂಪ 'ಪುನರಾವೃತ್ತಿ' (ಅಥವಾ ಪುನರುಕ್ತಿ).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ವಾಕ್ಯದೋಷ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಆದೇಶ ಅಥವಾ ಕಡತಕ್ಕೆ ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸಲಾಗುವ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪದ ಯಾವುದು?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ಕಂದಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಆಡಳಿತದಲ್ಲಿ 'File' ಗೆ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಕನ್ನಡ ಪಾರಿಭಾಷಿಕ ಪದ 'ಕಡತ'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕನ್ನಡ (ಆಡಳಿತ ಕನ್ನಡ)

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: 'She sang **beautifully** during the national anthem.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Beautifully' modifies the verb 'sang', answering how she sang, hence it is an Adverb of manner.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which of the following is an abstract noun?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Honesty' denotes a state, quality, or concept that cannot be physically touched, making it an Abstract Noun.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank with the correct preposition: 'The Village Administrative Officer has been working in this taluk office _____ 2021.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Since' is used to denote a specific point of time in the past when an action started in the Present Perfect Continuous tense.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'He jumped _____ the river to save the drowning boy.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Into' indicates movement or motion entering from the outside toward the interior of an enclosed space.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Choose the correct tense form: 'The sun _____ in the east and sets in the west.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Universal truths, scientific facts, and habitual actions are always expressed in the Simple Present tense.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank: 'By this time tomorrow, the surveyor _____ the entire village boundary.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Actions that will be finished before a specific deadline in the future use the Future Perfect tense ('will have completed').
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank: 'When the police arrived at the village, the thief _____.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: When two actions happened in the past, the earlier completed action takes the Past Perfect tense ('had already fled').
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Choose the correct verb form: 'Neither of the two survey sketches _____ approved by the Tahsildar.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb ('is') because it refers to not one and not the other individually.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank: 'The Deputy Commissioner, along with his staff members, _____ inspecting the drought-affected fields.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: When a subject is connected by 'along with', 'as well as', or 'with', the verb agrees strictly with the first subject ('Deputy Commissioner' = singular 'is').
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank: 'Ten thousand rupees _____ a reasonable revenue assessment for this commercial plot.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: When a specific sum of money represents a collective single quantity or amount, it takes a singular verb ('is').
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank: 'Bread and butter _____ his daily breakfast.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: When two nouns together express a single combined idea or dish, the verb is singular ('is').
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Convert into Passive Voice: 'The surveyor mapped the boundary lines.'
options: The boundary lines are mapped by the surveyor.
The boundary lines were mapped by the surveyor.
The boundary lines had been mapped by the surveyor.
The boundary lines will be mapped by the surveyor.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Simple Past Active ($S + V_2 + O$) transforms into $O + \text{was/were} + V_3 + \text{by } S$.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Convert into Passive Voice: 'The committee is evaluating the mutation petitions.'
options: The mutation petitions are evaluated by the committee.
The mutation petitions were evaluated by the committee.
The mutation petitions are being evaluated by the committee.
The mutation petitions have been evaluated by the committee.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Present Continuous transforms with 'being': $\text{is/are} + \text{being} + V_3$.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Convert into Passive Voice: 'Who wrote this revenue report?'
options: By whom was this revenue report written?
By whom this revenue report was written?
Who was this revenue report written?
By whom is this revenue report written?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Who' becomes 'By whom', followed by auxiliary verb 'was' + subject + $V_3$.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Change into Indirect Speech: He said, 'I am preparing the village survey records today.'
options: He said that he is preparing the village survey records today.
He said that he was preparing the village survey records that day.
He said that he had prepared the village survey records that day.
He said that he prepared the village survey records today.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Present continuous ('am preparing') shifts to past continuous ('was preparing'), and 'today' becomes 'that day'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Change into Indirect Speech: The Tahsildar said to the clerk, 'Submit the file immediately.'
options: The Tahsildar asked the clerk that he should submit the file immediately.
The Tahsildar ordered the clerk to submit the file immediately.
The Tahsildar requested the clerk to submit the file immediately.
The Tahsildar told to the clerk to submit the file immediately.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Imperative orders transform using reporting verb 'ordered' followed by infinitive 'to submit'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the SYNONYM of the word **'DILIGENT'**?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Diligent' means showing steady, persistent, and earnest energetic effort (hardworking).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the SYNONYM of the word **'CANDID'**?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Candid' means truthful, straightforward, and outspoken without concealment.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the ANTONYM of the word **'OBSOLETE'**?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Obsolete' means no longer produced or used; its opposite is modern or current.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the ANTONYM of the word **'FRUGAL'**?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Frugal' means sparing or economical with money; its direct antonym is extravagant.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Give one word for: **'A person who writes and compiles dictionaries'**
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: A 'Lexicographer' compiles dictionaries; a 'Cartographer' drafts maps.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Give one word for: **'One who is all-powerful'**
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Omnipotent' means having unlimited or universal power.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the meaning of the idiom: **'To burn the midnight oil'**?
options: To work or study late into the night
To set fire to a property
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'To burn the midnight oil' means to read, study, or work hard late into the night.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the meaning of the idiom: **'A blessing in disguise'**?
options: An apparent misfortune that eventually produces beneficial results
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: A blessing in disguise is something that appears unfortunate at first but later proves advantageous.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the meaning of the idiom: **'To break the ice'**?
options: To relieve tension and start a conversation in an awkward social situation
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'To break the ice' means to overcome social awkwardness and initiate friendly conversation.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Choose the phrasal verb that means **'to cancel or terminate an event'**:
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Call off' means to cancel an event, meeting, or strike.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Identify the part of the sentence containing an error: 'Neither the teacher (A) / nor the students (B) / was present in the meeting (C) / No error (D)'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: When subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('students' is plural $\implies$ should be 'were present').
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Identify the error: 'He is senior (A) / than me (B) / in government service (C) / No error (D)'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Adjectives ending in '-ior' (senior, junior, prior, superior) take the preposition 'to', never 'than' ('senior to me').
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Choose the correctly spelt word:
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: The correct spelling is **'Accommodation'** (double 'c' and double 'm').
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Choose the correctly spelt word:
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: The correct spelling is **'Bureaucracy'**.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank with the correct article: 'He is _____ honest officer serving in the Revenue Department.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a silent 'h' and vowel sound /ɒ/, requiring the indefinite article 'an'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank: 'If you work hard, you _____ the competitive exam.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: First conditional clause (Simple Present in 'if' clause) takes 'will + verb' in the main clause.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Fill in the blank: 'He prevented me _____ entering the restricted revenue record room.'
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: The verb 'prevent' is always followed by the preposition 'from' + gerund ('prevented from entering').
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Choose the sentence with correct word order:
options: Hardly had he left the office when it began to rain.
Hardly he had left the office when it began to rain.
Hardly had he left the office than it began to rain.
Hardly he left the office then it began to rain.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Negative adverb 'Hardly' requires inverted auxiliary ('had he left') followed by conjunction 'when'.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the plural form of the word **'Criterion'**?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: 'Criterion' (Greek singular) becomes 'Criteria' in plural form.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: General English

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which generation of computers introduced integrated circuits (ICs) replacing discrete transistors?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Third generation computers (1964–1971) used Integrated Circuits (ICs), invented by Jack Kilby.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which component of the CPU acts as the supervisor, directing data flows and coordinating instruction execution?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: The Control Unit (CU) fetches, decodes, and manages the execution of instructions across all hardware components.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which is the fastest and smallest memory unit located directly inside the CPU chip?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Registers are high-speed internal memory cells operating at processor clock speed.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the full form of **ROM** in computer architecture?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: ROM stands for Read Only Memory, which holds non-volatile system startup code (BIOS/UEFI).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Why is Solid State Drive (SSD) storage preferred over traditional Hard Disk Drive (HDD)?
options: Uses flash NAND memory with zero moving parts, providing vastly higher read/write speeds
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: SSDs use semiconductor flash memory with zero mechanical latency, resulting in faster boot times and file transfers.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which of the following is classified as an Open-Source Operating System?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Linux is an open-source OS distributed freely with open access to its source code kernel.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which standard file extension represents a non-editable, standardized document format used for issuing official government orders and RTC copies?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: `.pdf` (Portable Document Format) preserves layout across devices and is the standard for official digital documents.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: In Microsoft Word, what is the keyboard shortcut to 'Justify' selected text alignment?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: `Ctrl + J` justifies text, aligning it evenly along both left and right margins.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: In MS Word, which function key initiates the Spelling and Grammar check dialog box?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Pressing F7 in MS Word initiates the Spelling and Grammar check.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which feature in MS Word allows a Village Administrative Officer to generate hundreds of individual tax notices from an Excel database?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Mail Merge links a master document template to a recipient database to batch-produce individualized notices.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: In Microsoft Excel, what type of cell reference is designated by the formula syntax `=$B$5`?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: The dollar signs before both column ($B) and row ($5) fix the reference so it never changes when copied.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: In MS Excel, which formula function counts all non-empty cells in a range, including cells containing text and numbers?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: `=COUNTA()` counts all cells containing any content; `=COUNT()` counts numeric values only.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: In MS Excel, what is the default alignment for text and numbers respectively in cells?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Excel automatically aligns text to the left and numerical figures to the right.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: In Microsoft PowerPoint, which keyboard shortcut starts the slide show presentation from the very first slide?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: F5 starts the slide show from Slide 1; Shift + F5 starts from the currently active slide.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: In MS PowerPoint, what is the term for visual motion effects applied to individual text or objects within a single slide?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Animations govern movements of elements within a slide; Transitions govern movement between slides.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the address length in bits of an Internet Protocol version 4 (IPv4) address?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: IPv4 addresses are 32 bits long, divided into 4 octets separated by dots (e.g., 192.168.1.1).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the address length in bits of an Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) address?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: IPv6 addresses are 128 bits long, written as 8 groups of hexadecimal digits separated by colons.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which network topology connects all nodes to a single central network switch or hub?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: In a Star topology, all computers connect individually to a central switch or hub.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the function of the Domain Name System (DNS) on the internet?
options: Translate human-readable domain names (e.g. karnataka.gov.in) into machine-readable IP addresses
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: DNS acts as the phonebook of the internet, resolving domain names into numerical IP addresses.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which application protocol is used for sending outgoing electronic mail messages?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: SMTP (Port 25) sends/pushes email messages; POP3 and IMAP retrieve emails.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the key advantage of IMAP over POP3 for managing email communications?
options: IMAP synchronizes email state across multiple devices in real-time on the server
IMAP downloads all emails and deletes them from the server
IMAP does not require internet connection
IMAP is free while POP3 is paid
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: IMAP keeps emails stored on the mail server and synchronizes read/unread status across smartphones and PCs.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which cyberattack involves deceptive emails or fraudulent links designed to trick employees into revealing passwords?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Phishing uses fraudulent communication masquerading as a trustworthy entity to steal credentials.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What type of malware encrypts files and demands cryptocurrency payments for restoration?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Ransomware locks or encrypts data files and demands monetary extortion for restoration.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: In Karnataka, which pioneering e-governance software computerized 20 million rural land records, issuing Form 16 RTCs?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Bhoomi was launched in Karnataka in 2000–2002 to computerize Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops (RTC).
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Under Section 129 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, Bhoomi processes land mutation petitions based on which principle?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Bhoomi strictly enforces First-In, First-Out (FIFO) processing to prevent bribery and arbitrary delays.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which mobile application developed by KSRSAC allows Karnataka citizens to see cadastral survey numbers at their live GPS location?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Dishank uses smartphone GPS to display real-time cadastral survey numbers, village boundaries, and land classification.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the name of Karnataka's online unified property registration portal integrated with Bhoomi and e-Swathu?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Kaveri 2.0 is Karnataka's web-based deed registration software linking directly to Bhoomi for instant mutation initiation.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which digital database implemented by the Centre for e-Governance in Karnataka serves as a single source of truth for citizen beneficiary verification?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: The Kutumba platform integrates social security, PDS, and departmental databases to establish entitlement families.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: What is the primary function of a network **Firewall** in cybersecurity?
options: Monitor and filter incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predetermined security rules
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: A firewall creates a protective barrier between a trusted internal network and untrusted external networks like the internet.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge

paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.text: Which shortcut key combination is used in Windows to permanently delete a selected file bypassing the Recycle Bin?
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.explanation: Pressing `Shift + Delete` permanently removes a file immediately without sending it to the Recycle Bin.
paper_2_language_and_computer_knowledge.subject: Computer Knowledge
